title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 18 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 18)

content.overview: Section 18 requires equal treatment of the parties and a full opportunity for each party to present its case. The standard applies to procedural opportunities in pleadings, evidence, hearings and response and is a core statutory guarantee of procedural fairness.
content.glance: Section 18 requires equal treatment of the parties and a full opportunity for each party to present its case. The standard applies to procedural opportunities in pleadings, evidence, hearings and response and is a core statutory guarantee of procedural fairness.
content.study:
Section 18 — Equal treatment of parties

Section 18 requires equal treatment of the parties and a full opportunity for each party to present its case. The standard applies to procedural opportunities in pleadings, evidence, hearings and response and is a core statutory guarantee of procedural fairness.

Apply the provision by identifying its operative conditions, procedural stage, connected statutory provisions and precise consequence. Do not substitute generic arbitration practice for the statutory rule.
